title: Astral Dragon Sprayer
description: A Black girl with curly hair stands on a floating, cracked platform, wearing a cape and boots while holding a spray can that emits colorful cosmic mist. She has a large green scaled dragon tail and is surrounded by vibrant rainbow drips, flowers, small creatures, and swirling galaxies against a starry black background.
prompt: A Black girl with curly hair and a long green scaled dragon tail stands on a cracked floating platform, wearing boots and a flowing cape. She holds a spray can emitting swirling purple and blue cosmic clouds. The scene features vibrant rainbow paint dripping from the edges, glowing flowers, small blue creatures, and two large spiral galaxies floating in a starry black sky, surreal and vibrant street art style.
